title: Kenyan Chicken Lasagna
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Chicken Lasagna — layers of pasta with a creamy spiced chicken and mushroom filling and golden béchamel. The lighter, equally beloved alternative to the beef version — particularly popular with families who prefer chicken.
longDesc: The chicken lasagna version uses a creamy chicken and mushroom filling instead of the tomato-based bolognese, producing a lighter, creamier result that many prefer. The Kenyan spicing of the filling with paprika and coriander gives it local character.
steps: Cook chicken filling: sauté onion, garlic, and mushrooms in butter until golden. Add shredded chicken, paprika, oregano, cream, and stock. Simmer until thick. Add coriander.
Layer and bake as per KEN261 steps 3—7.
chefTips: Shred chicken finely for even distribution throughout the layers.
The chicken filling must be thick and dry before layering.
cookingScience: See KEN261 for lasagna baking science.
sustainabilityTips: Free-range Kenyan chicken for the best flavour and most sustainable choice.
healthBenefits: High protein from chicken and cheese.
culturalNote: Chicken lasagna demonstrates that Italian baked pasta has been fully absorbed into the Kenyan restaurant and home cooking repertoire — adapted with local spices and ingredients into something uniquely Kenyan.
